guidelines.detail: refines ACT-07 (The description says arrivals can occur in an arbitrary order and work starts when the first arrives (S6, S7). The flow records support modeling this trigger without waiting for all expected arrivals (F5, F20, F23). This refines ACT-07 by specifying how to handle concurrent occurrences when work begins after the first one.)

same as LRN-062 (The label pairs show generated labels expressing different decisions or activities from the corresponding reference labels, while the description provides the relevant stock decisions and actions. This is already covered in substance by learned guideline LRN-062.)

same as LRN-071 (The description says arrivals occur in a random order and work starts when the first arrives. This supports modeling the first arrival as a trigger rather than waiting for all arrivals, as also reflected by the missing flow in F5. The guideline is already covered by LRN-071.)

same as LRN-062 (The label pairs show elements whose labels express different meanings from the described steps; the description confirms the intended meanings. This guideline is already stated essentially the same way by learned guideline LRN-062.)

same as LRN-071 (The description explicitly says that arrivals are in a random order and work starts when the first parts arrive. This supports the missing flow from the first-arrival condition to the work. The learned guideline LRN-071 already states the same principle.)

same as LRN-062 (The label-pair records show BPMN labels expressing different decisions, activities, or triggers from those stated in the description. The learned guideline LRN-062 already expresses this same rule.)

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description states that work can start upon the first of several expected occurrences, without waiting for the others: Model the first occurrence as a trigger for the work, while allowing the remaining expected occurrences to proceed concurrently; do not synchronize all occurrences before starting the work.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states that work can start upon the first of several expected occurrences, without waiting for the others

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description states a specific action, decision, or outcome, but a generated BPMN element label expresses a different meaning: Label the element to preserve the meaning of the corresponding described step; do not substitute another action, decision, outcome, or an inferred purpose.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states a specific activity, decision, or outcome, but the corresponding BPMN element label expresses a different meaning
